title: Conforme and Time Connectors in Northern Mexico

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *conforme* and *al cabo de* from B2 Unit 2, and *a medida que* from B1 Unit 2. In a story, *conforme* shows two things changing together, little by little: *Conforme pasaban los días, se sentía mejor*. It is not only for stories about people: it is just as useful for a landscape that changes as you move through it, or for a region that changes as it grows. This lesson applies it to northern Mexico.

sections.title: Gradual, skipped or immediate
rows: Two changes together, little by little: Conforme se sube a la sierra, el clima cambia. (As you go up into the mountains, the climate changes.)
The same meaning: A medida que crecen las ciudades, hay menos agua. (As the cities grow, there is less water.)
Al cabo de + a length of time
A stretch of time is skipped: Al cabo de varios días, llegaron a la sierra. (After several days, they reached the mountains.)
The second event follows at once: Apenas salió el sol, empezó el calor. (As soon as the sun came up, the heat began.)

sections.title: Mood and tense
sections.content: With a real, repeated or past change, *conforme* takes the indicative: *Conforme se sube, hace menos calor* (a general fact), *Conforme pasaban los siglos, aprendieron a vivir con poca agua* (past, with the *imperfecto*). Unlike *apenas* and *al cabo de*, *conforme* does not mean that something happens at once or after a time: it means that the two things grow together.

items.spanish: Conforme se sube a la sierra, el clima cambia.
items.english: As you go up into the mountains, the climate changes.

items.spanish: Conforme pasaban los siglos, los pueblos del desierto aprendieron a vivir con poca agua.
items.english: As the centuries passed, the peoples of the desert learned to live with little water.

items.spanish: Conforme se descubrían minas de plata, llegaban colonos al norte.
items.english: As silver mines were discovered, settlers came to the north.

items.spanish: Conforme crecen las ciudades del norte, la falta de agua preocupa más.
items.english: As the cities of the north grow, the lack of water causes more concern.

items.spanish: Al cabo de varios días de viaje, llegaron a las barrancas.
items.english: After several days of travel, they reached the ravines.

sections.content: *Conforme* also means "in accordance with" (*conforme a la ley*). When a verb follows, as here, it means "as".
